notes:
One of five byte-identical pages in this batch -- Samurai, Dragoon, Corsair, Scholar and Ranger share the same wikitext (same source_sha256 across five different page_ids), so the only thing that separates them is the title and the quest id. Read as a player: this is a three-rung quest that starts and ends on the same NPC with a long grind in between. Bullet 3 is not a step -- it is the outcome of bullet 2, the way you know the grind is over -- so it is merged into step 2's source_bullets rather than given a rung of its own. The Skillchain/Trial Points table is bullet 2's data, not a step. The whole 'After the walkthrough: Notes' section is genuinely notes: the four progress-gauge lines you can get by trading early, the warning that storing the weapon with Ghanraam at Aht Urhgan Whitegate (K-10) RESETS your points, the fact that the weapon is still good for the Mythic acquisition quests afterwards, and two paragraphs of version history. None of it is a step, and Ghanraam in particular is a trap to avoid, not a place to send anyone. THE ITEM PROBLEM: the header's Item Req and every step's requirement is 'a Vigil Weapon equipped', but 'Vigil Weapon' is a CATEGORY -- each job's is a different item -- and the page never names Samurai's. It does not resolve as an item or a key item, and inventing the specific weapon name is exactly what rule 1 forbids, so items stays [] on all three steps with items_partial set to say the list is not the whole story. Nothing is observable anywhere in this quest: no key item is granted, the Weapon Skill Points are invisible to the addon, and the Vigil Weapon is handed straight back after the trade, so evidence is null throughout and the ladder rests on the session latch. The job gate is not stated in any header field; it is read off the quest's own title and dat_name, and off the reward line 'your job's Mythic Weapon Skill' -- flagged so a human can overrule it.

VIGIL WEAPON PINNED. The page says only "a Vigil Weapon equipped" and never names it, so the reading pass was right to leave it unresolvable -- 'Vigil Weapon' is a wiki CATEGORY, not an item. The job -> weapon mapping lives on Category:Vigil_Weapons, which is not in the scrape; it was fetched once and recorded in bgwiki-rest-cache/supplemental/vigil_weapons.json. This job's weapon is a real item with a real id, so the requirement is now checkable. Caveat kept honest: the quest wants it EQUIPPED and the addon can only see that you HOLD it, which is the near-miss direction -- you are one keystroke from ready rather than being told you are ready when you are not. | CORRECTED provenance: this page is reached through the redirect 'Unlocking a Myth (Samurai)'. The record previously cited the STUB's page id and revision, whose content is a single #REDIRECT line -- not the wikitext the ladder was read from. It now cites the article.

Moved out of the player-facing step notes (build vocabulary; see AUTHORING.md, 'Two notes, two audiences'):
  step 1: A Vigil Weapon must be EQUIPPED for the cutscene, but the page names no specific weapon and 'Vigil Weapon' does not resolve, hence items [] with items_partial.

steps.note: the grind: kill anything worth experience (Incredibly Easy Prey or better) with the SAME Vigil Weapon in the main hand and land Weapon Skills, until 250 Weapon Skill Points -- 5 per unchained WS, 7/9/11 for a level 1/2/3 Skillchain. Weapon Skills used before the quest was flagged do not count. No zone: it happens anywhere. Bullet 3 is the outcome, not a step -- the new Weapon Skill simply appears in your list, and only while the Vigil Weapon is equipped. Nothing here is observable, so no evidence.

trade the Vigil Weapon back to him; he unlocks the Weapon Skill for any weapon of the type and RETURNS the weapon, so holding it proves nothing either side of this step. Same unnamed-item problem as step 1.
